verdict: A top-3 account at 4T 613G in Conquest. Damage now comes from rune grades, plating to +20 and Lv.119; the beam order is set per mode.

items.action: Reroll the dead rune lines on the Conquest buffers
items.why: Skating Queen C Resistance, Cheesecake U DEF AMP and U CRIT%, Pomegranate R CRIT DMG do nothing for buffs.
items.payoff: Each becomes ~4.4–5.0 Skill AMP on a buffer; +1% Skill AMP ≈ +2% damage (leaked sheet, claimed).

items.action: Reroll Milk's four SR ATK AMP lines toward SSR
items.why: SR 4.2, 4.7, 4.2, 4.2 where SSR rolls 6.1–7.0; her buff scales with her ATK.
items.payoff: About +9 ATK AMP on the buff source, which also keeps her ATK #1.

items.action: At Crumble Lv.195, level Milk to 119, then Brightseeker
items.why: The cap opens one cookie level per 5 Crumble levels past 100. Milk must stay ATK #1 for both perks.
items.payoff: Base stats on the buff source and the carry; one posted step to the cap was +7.5% team power.
items.cost: 28.0M EXP per cookie; 40.6M banked. The stage-pushing levels on Pinot and Dark Choco come back on reset.

items.action: Before Conquest, set Passion Pay and Rapid Promotion on Milk
items.why: Perks are one setting shared by every mode, so a stage or Arena setup carries into Conquest. Not read this audit.
items.payoff: Passion Pay +20% ATK and Rapid Promotion +7% ATK on the top attacker.

items.action: Plate every slot to +17, then the book and artifact to +20
items.why: Sub-stats rise only at +20. Without bought Syrup, posters take all to +17 first, then the book and artifact.
items.payoff: Book at +20: about +3 Skill AMP and +1.4 haste. A +20 weapon: about +2.7 Skill AMP and +5 CRIT DMG.
items.cost: 19→20 ≈ 1,190 Chocosteel and 428 Syrup; you have 535 and 26. Mileage sells 50 of each a week. Use drop protection only.

items.action: Buy the artisan check-in pack before 10-22, if paying
items.why: 100 Chocosteel and 100 Syrup for ₩25,000; the round rates it buy.
items.payoff: About a fifth of one 19→20 step.

items.action: Spend Arena attempts on Fame; 134 needs 200 medals
items.why: Fame is pure damage: each level adds 2% to boss, elemental or crit damage in turn. 17 medals on hand.
items.payoff: Fame 134: elemental 88% → 90%, about +1% damage.
items.cost: Arena attempts; ticket packs are the paid route.

items.action: Promote Brightseeker and Cheesecake to 10★
items.why: Their 10★ rune lines are already rolled (SSR haste; SSR Skill AMP 5.0). Stars also open Stellar points.
items.payoff: Two more lines each, without crystals.

items.action: Keep the Gnome Lab running; fill the cheap crit nodes
items.why: Research takes 12 h at most since 10-08, so stones limit it. Crit rate past 100% double- and triple-crits.
items.payoff: Small stats per node; crit rate and crit DMG both count in Conquest.

items.action: Finish Oven 40
items.why: Gear level caps at oven × 3: 117 now, 120 at 40.
items.payoff: Higher main stats on every new drop.

items.action: Spend Stellar Points when constellation 8's 8th point opens
items.why: 7 points cap the area near 87% (you're at 86%); the 8th opens at 735 cookie stars (722 now) and lifts the cap to ~90%.
items.payoff: Up to ~+4% area, ×1.3 amplification on constellation 8.
items.cost: ~1,900 SP for the octagon; 44,630 banked. Lock points before rerolling.

items.action: Raise Tea Knight to 7★ as the event allows
items.why: Her Boss DMG buff is 60% at 5★, 65% at 7★; her ★6 and ★8 rune slots hold SSR Skill AMP 4.4, 4.4 and 4.7.
items.payoff: A bigger Conquest-only buff and three Skill AMP lines.

items.action: Replace the crit-RES lines on BR2 and BR3 from Oven drops
items.why: Crit RES does nothing against the boss; it only pads displayed power.
items.payoff: DR or haste instead: survival past the 17 s wipe.

items.action: Reset Cool Mint, Licorice, Cream Soda, Shortcake and Lemon to Lv.1
items.why: Excluded chargers, summoners and projectile cookies in the top 40 pull Milk away from the dealers.
items.payoff: One measurement: benching Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint gave +42%. You score 128G; the meta deck makes 379G.
items.cost: Free; none of them is in your lineups.

items.action: Swap Icy Birdie for King Choco Drop in Rumble defense
items.why: Over 95% of top-100 Rumble teams run King Choco Drop. Yours sits unused at 10★.
items.payoff: +16% max HP for the whole team.

items.action: Put Cherry Cola in Doughnut King's slot in Rumble defense
items.why: The meta slot r2-5 is the third charger. Vampire is the alternative.
items.payoff: Matches 9 of the 12 fully revealed top-100 teams.
items.cost: Free. Re-check once Season 2's buff shows.

items.action: Test Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in a spare Arena attack lineup
items.why: Your Bari is 8★, past the 7★ line where Bari beats Rye at equal spec.
items.payoff: The record's top Arena deck. You're 4th with the Rye deck.

items.action: Then level the PvP twelve to 120
items.why: Level counts in Arena; Resolve, Stellar, the labs and Fame don't.
items.payoff: PvP stats at the new cap.

items.action: Rune Bari for haste and DR; tank Hound, Ion and Oven
items.why: Bari wants about 45 haste; yours runs ATK lines. Hound's runes are offensive.
items.payoff: Full Soul Guidance uptime, and PvP tanks that hold.
items.cost: Rune crystals. Bari's ATK lines also serve the Rift.

items.action: In Rift Season 2, run the levelled-Rye setup
items.why: Non-dealers at Lv.64–70 stack the ATK-ordered buffs on Brightseeker, Rye and Cherry Cola.
items.payoff: The record's furthest 15% clear. You run Bari, Crepe and Moon Rabbit instead.

items.action: Promote Continuum Cog from 0★ (0/1)
items.why: It gives +50% boss DMG in the Rift even at base.
items.payoff: Unmeasured.

items.action: Reset Bari, Oven and Cherry Cola only for Dungeon sessions
items.why: The Dungeon records exclude them, but they're your PvP core.
items.payoff: Completes the exclusion list.
items.cost: PvP defense is weaker while they sit at Lv.1.

items.action: Re-pick the Rumble deck once the Season 2 buff shows
items.why: Season 1's Charge HP +30% propped up Bari and Oven.
items.payoff: The defense fits the new passive.

items.action: Take Bari to 9★ through the pickup counter
items.why: The counter is at 3,017 of 3,060, and Bari's strength scales with stars.
items.payoff: More Bari DR and a shorter cooldown.

items.action: Star up King Choco Drop (10★, 1/4)
items.why: It's the top Rumble pet; its HP grant grows with stars.
items.payoff: More team HP in Rumble.

parked.why: 86% is within ~1% of the heptagon ceiling.
+19 raises only the flat main stat; sub-stats wait for +20.
The Conquest boss is weak to Light and the carries are Light.
1.46T coins a level for flat stats; power only.
Power isn't damage; rank by damage or score.
They rank by crystal value, not damage.
